title: DNA extraction from FTA Classical Card
author: Adebambo
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.ihvcb66

steps.title: Punch disks from FTA cards
steps.instruction: Punch five (5) 1 mm disks from each blood‑stained FTA® card using a Harris micro‑punch and place the disks into individual Eppendorf tubes.

steps.title: Add Tris and SDS solution
steps.instruction: Add 100 mM Tris‑BASE and 0.1 % (w/v) Sodium Dodecyl Sulphate (SDS) to each tube containing the disks.

steps.title: Incubate at 30 °C with agitation
steps.instruction: Place the tubes in a water bath, agitate gently on a mixer for 30 minutes at 30 °C.

steps.title: Remove supernatant
steps.instruction: Carefully empty the solution from each tube, leaving the disks behind.

steps.title: Second wash with guanidine thiocyanate
steps.instruction: Add 0.5 mL of 5 M guanidine thiocyanate to each tube and mix for 10 minutes.

steps.title: First distilled water wash
steps.instruction: Remove as much guanidine thiocyanate solution as possible, leaving the disks in the tubes; add 0.5 mL distilled water and gently agitate for 10 minutes.

steps.title: Second distilled water wash
steps.instruction: After removing the first distilled water, add another 0.5 mL distilled water, let stand for 10 minutes.

steps.title: Heat at 90 °C
steps.instruction: With the 0.5 mL distilled water still present, place the tubes in a water bath at 90 °C for 10 minutes.

steps.title: Use eluate for PCR
steps.instruction: Leave the final distilled water in the Eppendorf tubes; this eluate serves as the template for downstream PCR amplification.
